$comment: Advisories the audit gate excludes, one entry per GHSA per scope.
Every field is mandatory and `expires` is enforced: an expired entry stops excluding
and the gate goes red again, so an exception cannot quietly become permanent.
Add an entry only with evidence that the code path is unreachable or the risk is
genuinely accepted; a new advisory on the same package is NOT covered.

exceptions.reason: Unreachable: image-size is pptxgenjs' Node-only path and Vite tree-shakes it out of the browser bundle. No fixed version exists — the advisory range is '*' and 2.0.2 is the newest release.
exceptions.evidence: grep -c 'image-size\|imageSize' ui/dist/assets/pptxgen.es-*.js -> 0; grep -oE 'icns|readUInt32BE' on the same bundle -> no match; npm view image-size dist-tags -> { latest: '2.0.2', legacy: '1.2.1' }; overrides to ^2.0.2 was tried and audit stayed red. devlog/_plan/260812_navrail_grok_autotag/040_closeout.md

exceptions.reason: Same unreachable dependency as GHSA-w3rx-r6r6-pgpr: JXL/HEIF parsers in the Node-only path that never reaches the browser bundle.
exceptions.evidence: See GHSA-w3rx-r6r6-pgpr above; both advisories resolve to the single image-size dependency of pptxgenjs@4.0.1.
